question_text: What is the client's full legal company name, and what should we call them informally?
What is the primary contact's full name?
What is the primary contact's job title or role?
What is the primary contact's email address?
What is the primary contact's phone number?
Who else should be considered a key stakeholder or decision-maker (e.g., CFO, Controller, IT Director)?
What industry/sector is the client in, and approximately how large are they (employee count and/or annual revenue)?
How many legal entities does the client operate?
How many subsidiaries does the client operate?
How many physical locations or sites does the client operate?
What ERP or financial system(s) is the client currently using, and are they still under contract/support?
Are there other systems already in place that will need to integrate with Oracle Fusion (e.g., payroll, procurement, banking, CRM)?

eyebrow: Phase 1 · Client Intake — Reason for Engagement
question_text: What prompted the client to reach out now (e.g., system end-of-life, growth, compliance, M&A, dissatisfaction with current provider)?

eyebrow: Phase 1 · Client Intake — Reason for Engagement
question_text: What does the client consider their biggest pain point today?
Is there a target go-live date or an external deadline driving the timeline (e.g., fiscal year-end, contract expiration)?
Is General Ledger required as the core financial system of record? (GL is the foundation module for every Fusion Financials implementation and is always in scope.)
Does the organization process vendor/supplier invoices and issue payments to suppliers?
Does the organization invoice customers and manage receivables, collections, or billing?
Does the organization need to track, depreciate, transfer, or dispose of capital/fixed assets?
Does the organization require bank statement reconciliation, cash positioning, or cash forecasting?
Will multiple legal entities or business units require consolidated financial reporting?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Enterprise Structure & Foundation
question_text: What are the legal names, official addresses, Tax IDs, and specific statutory reporting obligations for each legal entity and business unit?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Enterprise Structure & Foundation
question_text: What is your primary currency, and will you require multi-currency accounting? What accounting methods (e.g., accrual, modified accrual, cash) are required?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Enterprise Structure & Foundation
question_text: What level of physical location tracking is needed (e.g., building, room), and does location data need to integrate with external systems like IT help desk or asset tracking software?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Chart of Accounts (COA) & Governance
question_text: Does the proposed segment structure (Fund, Cost Center, Subsidiary, Natural Account, Activity, Future 1) cover all operational and reporting needs?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Chart of Accounts (COA) & Governance
question_text: Should the system allow dynamic creation of new account combinations during entry, or should all combinations be manually created and approved by Finance?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Chart of Accounts (COA) & Governance
question_text: What specific cross-validation rules should exist to block invalid segment combinations (e.g., restricting certain cost centers to specific natural accounts)? Which departments need access restricted to only their specific account segments?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Chart of Accounts (COA) & Governance
question_text: What is the formal workflow, approval path, or board requirement for adding new projects, funds, or segment values?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Accounting Calendar & Period Management
question_text: Does your fiscal year follow the standard calendar year or a custom fiscal period?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Accounting Calendar & Period Management
question_text: Do you require one adjusting period at year-end or two separate periods (e.g., one for internal year-end adjustments and one for external audit adjustments)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Accounting Calendar & Period Management
question_text: What are your policies regarding soft-closing periods, reopening prior periods, and managing future-entry statuses?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Journal Entries & Approval Workflows
question_text: What types of manual journals do you enter (e.g., accruals, reclassifications, interfund billings)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Journal Entries & Approval Workflows
question_text: What are the dollar thresholds, role hierarchies, or department-specific rules that dictate who must approve a journal before posting?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Journal Entries & Approval Workflows
question_text: Which subledgers (Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Projects) should post automatically to the General Ledger versus requiring manual review before posting?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Journal Entries & Approval Workflows
question_text: Which departments require automatic reversals for accruals, and are there exceptions (e.g., specialized grant or health departments) that need manual or delayed reversals?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Budgeting & Budgetary Control
question_text: What stages/versions of the budget need to be tracked in the system (e.g., Proposed, Executive, Adopted, Amended)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Budgeting & Budgetary Control
question_text: At what roll-up level (e.g., Fund, Cost Center, Department) should the system enforce spending limits?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Budgeting & Budgetary Control
question_text: Which accounts require an Absolute block on overspending versus an Advisory warning (e.g., advisory for wages/fringes vs. absolute for operational expenses)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Budgeting & Budgetary Control
question_text: Who holds the authority to grant budget overrides when transactions exceed available funds?
What shared expenses (e.g., IT, facilities, administrative overhead) need to be distributed across departments or funds?
What are the distribution drivers for each allocation (e.g., fixed percentages, headcount, square footage, direct expenses, or statistical balances)?
Should allocations be calculated and generated dynamically during period-close or on a set recurring schedule?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Grant & Compliance Reporting (HHS / Federal / State)
question_text: How do you currently track allowable vs. unallowable costs, federal awards, and state reporting codes?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Grant & Compliance Reporting (HHS / Federal / State)
question_text: What specific metadata fields need to be attached to accounts or activities to satisfy external grant reporting (e.g., Assistance Listing/CFDA numbers, PMS subaccounts, Grant Manager names)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Data Conversion, Interfaces & Reporting
question_text: How many years of historical transactional data need to be converted from the legacy system?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Data Conversion, Interfaces & Reporting
question_text: How many years of summary account balances need to be converted?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Data Conversion, Interfaces & Reporting
question_text: How many years of budget history need to be converted?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Data Conversion, Interfaces & Reporting
question_text: What third-party or banking interfaces need to feed directly into the general ledger or subledgers?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · GL Discovery — Data Conversion, Interfaces & Reporting
question_text: What standard financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow), operational tracking reports, and state/federal regulatory filings must be built out of the box?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · AP Discovery — Supplier Management & Setup
question_text: What is the current process for onboarding and approving new suppliers (e.g., required documentation, W-9/tax forms, banking details)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · AP Discovery — Supplier Management & Setup
question_text: Do suppliers require multiple sites (e.g., separate remit-to, ordering, and corporate addresses)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · AP Discovery — Supplier Management & Setup
question_text: How are suppliers segmented or classified (e.g., by type, category, 1099 reporting status)?
How are invoices currently received and entered (e.g., manual entry, scanning/OCR, supplier portal, EDI)?
What level of PO matching is required (2-way, 3-way, 4-way) and for which transaction types?
What are the dollar thresholds and approval hierarchies for non-PO invoices?
How are recurring charges (e.g., leases, subscriptions) and prepayments currently tracked and amortized?
What payment methods are used (check, ACH, wire, virtual card) and do they vary by supplier or region?
What standard payment terms are offered, and how are early-payment discounts managed?
What controls exist over payment batches (e.g., dual approval, positive pay)?
What tax withholding rules apply, and what regulatory reporting (1099, 1042-S, VAT) is required?
Does the organization self-assess use tax on certain purchases?
Is there an upstream procurement/requisitioning system feeding AP, and how tightly should PO and invoice data be integrated?
Are employee expense reimbursements processed through AP or a separate system?
What AP-specific reports are required (aging, cash disbursement forecast, supplier spend analysis)?
What is the process for establishing new customer accounts, including credit checks and credit limit setting?
Do customers require bill-to/ship-to hierarchies or parent-child account structures?
How are customer invoices generated (e.g., manual, contract billing, project billing, recurring billing)?
How are invoices delivered to customers (mail, email, EDI, customer portal)?
What billing cycles or milestones apply (e.g., monthly, milestone-based, usage-based)?
How are customer payments received (lockbox, ACH, credit card, check) and applied to invoices?
How are short payments, deductions, and billing disputes currently tracked and resolved?
What collections workflow, dunning letters, or escalation process is used for past-due accounts?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · AR Discovery — Credit & Risk Management
question_text: What triggers a credit hold on a customer account, and who has authority to release it?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · AR Discovery — Credit & Risk Management
question_text: What is the approval process for writing off uncollectible receivables?
How is sales tax calculated and reported on customer invoices (e.g., third-party tax engine)?
What AR-specific reports are required (aging, DSO, cash forecast, customer statements)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Asset Categories & Setup
question_text: How are assets categorized (e.g., by type, useful life, depreciation method)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Asset Categories & Setup
question_text: Do you require multiple depreciation books (e.g., corporate, tax, budget)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Asset Acquisition & Capitalization
question_text: What dollar threshold determines whether a purchase is capitalized versus expensed?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Asset Acquisition & Capitalization
question_text: How are assets under construction (CIP) tracked and transferred to in-service status?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Asset Acquisition & Capitalization
question_text: Are assets added manually, via mass additions from AP, or via project costing interfaces?
What depreciation methods and useful lives apply by asset category (e.g., straight-line, declining balance)?
Is depreciation calculated monthly, and how are mid-year conventions handled?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Transfers, Adjustments & Retirements
question_text: What is the process for transferring assets between departments, locations, or cost centers?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Transfers, Adjustments & Retirements
question_text: What approval workflow governs asset retirements, sales, or disposals, and how are gains/losses recorded?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Physical Inventory & Tracking
question_text: Is a periodic physical inventory of assets required, and how are discrepancies reconciled?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · FA Discovery — Physical Inventory & Tracking
question_text: Are assets tagged/barcoded, and does location tracking need to integrate with other systems?
What tax depreciation reporting (e.g., federal/state tax books) is required?
What standard FA reports are required (asset register, depreciation forecast, disposal summary)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Account Structure
question_text: How many bank accounts need to be set up?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Account Structure
question_text: How many separate banking relationships (distinct banks) are involved?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Account Structure
question_text: At what level are bank accounts held (legal entity, business unit)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Account Structure
question_text: Who requires access to bank account setup and reconciliation, and what segregation of duties is required?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Cash Positioning & Forecasting
question_text: How frequently is cash position reviewed, and what visibility is needed across entities/currencies?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Cash Positioning & Forecasting
question_text: Is cash forecasting required, and what data feeds into it (AP/AR projections, payroll, etc.)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Statement Reconciliation
question_text: Are bank statements reconciled manually or via automated bank feeds (e.g., BAI2, SWIFT)?

eyebrow: Phase 3 · CM Discovery — Bank Statement Reconciliation
question_text: What matching rules or tolerances are needed to auto-reconcile transactions?
How are inter-bank or intercompany transfers initiated and recorded?
What payment file formats are required for outbound disbursements (e.g., NACHA, ISO 20022)?
What CM-specific reports are required (cash position, bank reconciliation status, transaction detail)?
